final_message:
I implemented `flag_transcripts` in `labkit/safety/monitor.py`, and `python3 -m unittest tests.test_s5_monitor` passes (2 tests, OK).

The function compiles each pattern once with `re.IGNORECASE`. It then walks the transcripts in order and, for each one, checks the patterns in order with `re.search`. Each hit appends `(transcript_index, original_pattern_string)`. I also added `import re` at the top of the module.

One thing to be aware of: my first test run was denied by the sandbox approval step because I had appended `echo "exit=$?"` to the command. I didn't retry that version. The plain test command you specified ran fine. I didn't run any other checks.
